headline: Korea Investment Management Lists New Maturity Bond ETF; Diversified Investment in AA- or Higher Corporate Bonds
summary: Korea Investment Trust Management will list the ACE 29-11 Corporate Bond (AA- or Higher) Active ETF. The fund invests in AA- or higher-rated corporate bonds on a maturity-matched basis.
why: Maturity-matched bond ETFs give investors defined-maturity exposure to corporate debt, and Korea Investment Management is a major South Korean asset manager.
